title: The Insurance Act
verified_how: fetched the Office of the King's Printer Publications Centre record for product 103755 through the site's own JSON API (/api/v1/products/103755): name 'The Insurance Act', Chapter I-9.11 of The Statutes of Saskatchewan, 2015, effective 1 January 2020, as amended through 2024, 'Last update posted: 19 Aug 2024'
notes: In force since 1 January 2020, replacing the former Saskatchewan Insurance Act. The register's own record adds 'parts not yet proclaimed. Consult Legislative Tables of Statutes for effective dates', so anyone relying on a particular claims provision should confirm it against those Tables. Compulsory automobile injury compensation is separate: The Automobile Accident Insurance Act, R.S.S. c. A-35 (product 388).
